summary.note: 24 eligible apps receive official install routes. Cubiks 2048 is removed as client-only. CRM stays published because current upstream documents Docker self-hosting.

field_guard_assumptions: App updates require exact id, slug, published/self-hosting state, install URLs, deployment methods, Docker support, and Compose support from the read-only snapshot.
BugPin summary correction also matches its exact current summary before updating.
Install-option updates require options=[] and all 21 destination URL/image arrays empty.
Cubiks 2048 is the only unpublished row; the current app fields are guarded and no install-option row is changed.
Source links are merged. Relevant Docker/image/Compose technical-status keys are updated; unrelated app facts are preserved.
Migration draft has not been applied to production.
